title: detective-routing.json
description: Hand-off contract from the preventive root-cause critic to the detective generator. Written by skills/generate-preventive-rootcause at .service-approval/<slug>/05-generate/detective-routing.json when a preventive objective is NOT_PREVENTABLE (no condition key gates the action) and must be covered by a detective control instead. Consumed by skills/generate-detective, which generates detective coverage for each routed entry and fills in covered_by. validate_detective_routing.py confirms every routed entry is covered.

covered_by.description: Detective artifact filename(s) the generator produced to cover this routed objective, or null until covered.
